_comment: Deliberate changes made to the site for SEO reasons, with the date and the prediction recorded BEFORE the outcome is known. Written by hand.
_why: Without a prediction written down in advance, every outcome gets rationalised into a success. An experiment with no falsifiable prediction is not an experiment, it is a change.
_shape: { id, opened, page, change, prediction, evaluate_after, outcome: null | 'confirmed' | 'refuted' | 'inconclusive', closed, notes }
